ud3.6:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandaka nivāpe.
ud3.6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā pilindivaccho bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācarati.
ud3.6:1.4: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
ud3.6:2.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
ud3.6:2.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena pilindivacchaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi:
ud3.6:2.4: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā pilindivaccho tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ pilindivacchaṃ etadavoca:
ud3.6:3.1: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho āyasmā pilindivaccho tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ pilindivacchaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
ud3.6:3.2: ‘saccaṃ kira tvaṃ vaccha, bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācarasī”ti.
ud3.6:4.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato pilindivacchassa pubbenivāsaṃ manasi karitvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
ud3.6:4.2: “mā kho tumhe bhikkhave vacchassa bhikkhuno ujjhāyittha.
ud3.6:4.3: na bhikkhave vaccho dosantaro, bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācarati.
ud3.6:4.4: vacchassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañca jātisatāni abbokiṇṇāni brāhmaṇakule paccājātāni.
ud3.6:5.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud3.6:6.4: so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhū”ti.
